程序包 org.bukkit.util

类 Vector

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.util.Vector
所有已实现的接口:
Cloneable, ConfigurationSerializable
直接已知子类:
BlockVector
public class Vector extends Object implements Cloneable, ConfigurationSerializable
Represents a mutable vector. Because the components of Vectors are mutable, storing Vectors long term may be dangerous if passing code modifies the Vector later. If you want to keep around a Vector, it may be wise to call clone() in order to get a copy. 表示一个可变向量。由于 Vector 的分量是可变的，如果传递的代码稍后修改了 Vector，长期存储 Vector 可能是危险的。如果你想保留一个 Vector，调用 clone() 来获取一份副本可能是明智的。

    • length

      public double length()
      Gets the magnitude of the vector, defined as sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2). The value of this method is not cached and uses a costly square-root function, so do not repeatedly call this method to get the vector's magnitude. NaN will be returned if the inner result of the sqrt() function overflows, which will be caused if the length is too long. 获取该向量的模长，定义为 sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2)。此方法的值不会被缓存且使用代价高昂的平方根函数，因此不要反复调用此方法来获取向量的模长。如果 sqrt() 函数的内部结果溢出（长度过长时会如此），将返回 NaN。
      返回:
      the magnitude 模长

    • dot

      public double dot(Vector other)
      Calculates the dot product of this vector with another. The dot product is defined as x1*x2+y1*y2+z1*z2. The returned value is a scalar. 计算此向量与另一个向量的点积。点积定义为 x1*x2+y1*y2+z1*z2。返回值是一个标量。
      参数:
      other - The other vector 另一个向量
      返回:
      dot product 点积

    • crossProduct

      public Vector crossProduct(Vector o)
      Calculates the cross product of this vector with another. The cross product is defined as: 计算此向量与另一个向量的叉积。叉积定义为：
      • x = y1 * z2 - y2 * z1
      • y = z1 * x2 - z2 * x1
      • z = x1 * y2 - x2 * y1
      参数:
      o - The other vector 另一个向量
      返回:
      the same vector 同一向量

    • getCrossProduct

      public Vector getCrossProduct(Vector o)
      Calculates the cross product of this vector with another without mutating the original. The cross product is defined as: 计算此向量与另一个向量的叉积而不修改原向量。叉积定义为：
      • x = y1 * z2 - y2 * z1
      • y = z1 * x2 - z2 * x1
      • z = x1 * y2 - x2 * y1
      参数:
      o - The other vector 另一个向量
      返回:
      a new vector 新向量

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object obj)
      Checks to see if two objects are equal. 检查两个对象是否相等。

      Only two Vectors can ever return true. This method uses a fuzzy match to account for floating point errors. The epsilon can be retrieved with epsilon. 只有两个 Vector 才可能返回 true。此方法使用模糊匹配来考虑浮点误差。阈值可通过 epsilon 获取。
